definition: II. [ עָמַם ] verb darken, dim (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic cover, veil, conceal ; ᵑ7 עֲמַם grow dark ); — Qal Perfect 3 plural suffix עֲמָמֻהוּ Ezek 31:8 dubious, but probably (as Thes ) cedars did not eclipse him ; עֲמָמוּךָ Ezek 28:3 no secret do they hold dark (= is held dark) for thee ( Ges «GKC:117x»§ 117x ). Hoph`al Imperfect 3 masculine singular יוּעַם זָהָב Lam 4:1 (figurative) how is the gold dimmed ! compare Bu . עֲמָמִים , עַמְמֵי see I. עַם above עִמָּנוּאֵל see below עִם above
